summary_en: Special dividend program extended from FY3/24–3/28 (5 years) to FY3/24–3/29 (6 years). Uniform special dividend rate increased to 30 yen/share (from tiered 30–20–10). Ordinary dividend to continue at 50%+ payout ratio. Total special dividend over revised period: 180 yen/share (up 60 yen). Rationale: accumulated internal reserves exceed initial forecasts; increased payout to optimize capital efficiency and support ROE 8% medium-term target.
title_en: Notice of Change to Special Dividend Implementation Policy (Increased Dividend and Extended Period)
translation_en_brief: On 30 July 2026, Marusan Securities announced a change to its special dividend policy. The company previously committed to special dividends of 30 yen (FY3/24), 30 yen (FY3/25), 30 yen (FY3/26), 20 yen (FY3/27), and 10 yen (FY3/28)—totalling 120 yen over five years ending March 2028. Under the revised policy, the special dividend program extends one additional year to March 2029, and the annual rate is uniformly raised to 30 yen/share for all six fiscal years, yielding a revised total of 180 yen/share (an increase of 60 yen). Ordinary dividends will continue alongside special dividends under a 50%+ payout-ratio policy. The company cited stronger-than-expected internal reserves due to favourable market conditions; the increased dividend payout is intended to optimize capital efficiency and support achievement of the medium-term plan's ROE 8% target.
